name: Wood-Pawcatuck Wild and Scenic Community Grants

funder.name: Wood-Pawcatuck Wild and Scenic Rivers Stewardship Council

summary: Annual grants for projects that protect or enhance the river values of the Wood-Pawcatuck Watershed in Rhode Island and Connecticut, including ecosystems, land preservation, water quality and free-flowing rivers. Nonprofits, tribes, schools and public bodies can apply.

eligibility.rule: The project can meet the December 31, 2028 final report deadline.
The grant request excludes the purchase price of land or conservation rights.
Grant funds exclude federally mandated work, enforcement, mitigation, entertainment, lobbying and unlawful uses.
Proposed deliverables are not mandated as part of a regulatory requirement.
Required permits for the deliverables are obtained before the proposal is submitted
This grant will not be used as match for other federal grant funding

documents: Proof of necessary permits, if permits are needed
Budget breakdown for requested community grant funds

deadline.quote: Grant applications will be accepted via email to coordinator@WPWildRivers.org through December 29th, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Non-profit organizations; local, state, and regional governmental agencies and commissions; Tribal and First nations; public schools and other educational institutions.

geography.quote: the federally designated Wild and Scenic Wood-Pawcatuck Watershed's rivers and brooks

access.quote: Grant applications will be accepted via email to coordinator@WPWildRivers.org through December 29th, 2026.

amount.quote: you can apply for a grant between $2,000 to $20,000

pool.quote: the Stewardship Council has a total of $75,000 to distribute

co_finance_required.quote: Match, either funds or volunteer hours, is not required but would be given favorable consideration.

effort.quote: Applications will be accepted from October 1, 2026 through December 29, 2026.
Grant selection is a competitive process; submittal of a proposal does not guarantee funding

eligibility.quote: Due to our funding cycle, only grant requests that can meet a December 31, 2028 final report deadline are eligible to apply for this round of grants
Grant requests towards the purchase price of land or conservation rights are not eligible.

Funding may not be used for federally-mandated activities or to address violation enforcement requirements or mitigation. Funding may also not be used for entertainment, lobbying, illegal activities or any other restrictions associated with federal fund use.
Proposed deliverables that are mandated as part of a regulatory requirement are not eligible.
Required permits for proposed deliverables have not been obtained prior to submission of the grant proposal
Grant funds can be used as part of a larger project but cannot be used as a match for other federal grant funding.

after_award.quote: After completing a memorandum of understanding (MOA), successful applicants will receive 80% of the requested grant amount with the final 20% of the award disbursed upon completion of the final report (see below).

documents.quote: Attach a brief (one page) MS Word formatted narrative describing the project.
If permits are needed for the proposed deliverables, provide proof of necessary permits.
Include a budget breakdown for the requested community grant funds using the sample template below.
